positions.description: Guided, science-backed practices to help you sleep better.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: PredictAP is the first and only Intelligent Invoice Capture™ solution designed for the complexity of Real Estate AP. Using machine learning, PredictAP ingests and codes invoices, and integrates with your trusted AP workflow for review, approval, and payment. When paired with industry-leading AP automation solutions, PredictAP delivers massive cost savings and productivity growth.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Fritz is a platform for developers to put machine learning and AI into edge devices, like mobile phones. Getting machine learning models to run efficiently and fit the constraints of the devices is a really hard problem for developers. Our product allows for developers to get things like computer vision in their mobile apps without needing to become machine learning experts.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead
positions.description: Helping to make the internet free for the next billion.

positions.title: Cofounder & Product Lead
positions.description:
VerbalCare puts people first with unprecedented communication between patients and caregivers. By engaging patients and giving them the tools to verbalize their needs, we enable clinical staff to administer higher quality of care, patients to feel more empowered, and family members to feel at ease with the care of their loved ones.

Acquired by Medical Specialties Distributors (MSD) http://www.msdonline.com/download_files/msd_acquires_verbalcare.pdf

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked on the marketplace team in order to expand the HubSpot ecosystem and allow 3rd party companies, designers, and developers to provide services to HubSpot's 8000+ customers.

•Owned several projects with my tech lead in a 2 person development team.
•Grew the marketplace to include 3 different services that generated over $8 million for our providers.
•Built a new service for templates and integrated it with HubSpot’s core content services 
•Architected a statistics engine to track performance of the templates sold so that customers would be able to compare click rates of email templates, submission rates of landing pages, etc. 
•Created marketplace promotions in coordination with HubSpot’s marketing team that resulted in the highest lead generation numbers in HubSpot history. 
•Developed and owned 2 marketplace applications in my spare time that generated new leads for HubSpot customers

positions.title: Information Technologies Office/Lab Assistant
positions.description:
•Presented new technologies for academic programs to improve the online interaction with students
•Updated and managed the IT and Computer Science Department websites for MET
•Introduced Turning Point software and devices to faculty, which were used in several courses 
•Managed lab equipment to record lectures and allow virtual interaction 
•Trained and oversaw new employees to use multimedia equipment and manage classroom lectures

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•Developed embedded import testing in Java for custom fields for HubSpot's Contact System
•Created python post-deploy testing for multiple Hubspot API’s and achieved >90% test coverage
•Learned inbound marketing techniques from the pioneers of the industry
•Created a marketplace app that allowed Hubspot sales to find their connection to potential leads
•Worked with Hadoop and HubSpot's REST based APIs

positions.title: Bioinformatics Intern
positions.description:
•Created online programs for research scientists to analyze gene sets and lab results.
•Assisted Bioinformatics senior head, George Bell with a portion of his software TargetScan 5.0. 
•Organized and established an online database for stem cell researchers to handle their inventory.
•Built over 5 tools for Whitehead scientists to use.

volunteerExperiences.description: I've mentored an inner city high school team for the past 2 years, helping them start and run their own business with the primary goal of keeping them in school so that they have the choice of going off to a four year college of their choosing.

projects.title: Bitter Lacrosse
projects.description: Built a website with a custom CMS for BitterLacrosse. Design created by Amy Guan and backend development by Eric Hsiao.

projects.title: UrbanAmp
projects.description: Created a website for people to find and share events that their friends were going to around BU. The more events students shared and attended, the more loyalty points they acquired.

publications.title: BU alums give voice to patients with new 'Verbal' app
